Frequently Asked Questions

How often should I get my chimney cleaned? We recommend an annual sweep, especially if you use your fireplace regularly. Yearly maintenance helps prevent fires and costly damage. What’s the difference between a Level 1 and Level 2 inspection? A Level 1 inspection is a basic visual check. A Level 2 includes a video scan and is typically needed when buying or selling a home or after a major storm or structural event. Why does my fireplace smell in the summer? Warm weather and humidity can draw smoky or musty smells from your chimney. A thorough cleaning and deodorizing treatment can help. Can animals get into my chimney? Yes—squirrels, birds, and raccoons are common intruders. A chimney cap is your best defense against pests. Do you offer emergency chimney services? We do! Call us anytime if you're experiencing leaks, smoke issues, or urgent structural concerns. What causes chimney leaks and how can I prevent them? Leaks often stem from damaged flashing, cracked crowns, missing caps, or porous masonry. Regular inspections and waterproofing treatments can help prevent moisture intrusion and extend the life of your chimney. How do I know if my chimney needs repairs or just a cleaning? Signs like smoke backing up, visible cracks, odors, or water stains may indicate a need for repair. If you're unsure, a chimney inspection can determine whether cleaning alone is enough or if deeper issues exist.
